eyebrow.static: eyebrow authored inline as the first link in the Text field (default)
eyebrow.dynamic: eyebrow-dynamic variant class; topic text and link resolved from page metadata (topic / topic-link) with graceful fallback to no eyebrow

capabilities.notes: hero 3-row convention (image + text); presentation and eyebrow mode are variant classes, not content rows. Single-image cards view only; carousel/facts views are not supported

suitableFor: article highlight sections with background image
promotional banners with overlay content card
left- or right-aligned overlay content cards (align-left / align-right)
